texts.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它破碎的残骸中包含了大量的战斗计算机、模拟器、以及通讯阵列，因此我们的科学家认为这一定是某种“战略指挥中心”。
texts.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. Its shattered remains contain a plenitude of battlecomputers, simulators, and broadcasting arrays which leads our scientists to speculate it must have been some type of "Strategic Coordination Center".

texts.zh: 我们在[strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]发现了一座被毁的巨大空间站。它似乎是一座“战略指挥中心”的残骸。
texts.en: A massive, ruined space station has been discovered in [strategic_coordination_center_system.GetName]. It appears to be the remains of a "Strategic Coordination Center".

label.zh: 我们的永远不会被摧毁!
